text: The system shall find, at an interval of TBD, whether each system answers and the time that it takes to answer.
rationale: A system that stops cannot report that it stopped. RSK-AC-006, RSK-AD-005 and RSK-AU-006 are detected by the operational state that this gives.

text: The system shall find, at an interval of TBD, the storage and the memory of the host that are in use.
rationale: The host is small, and DEC-021 keeps life state until the user removes it, so the storage grows.

text: The system shall give, for each external service, the outcomes of the calls to it in the last TBD.
rationale: REQ-PL-017 names the state of the external sources. The system reaches no service (REQ-PL-033), so it finds the state of a service from the records of the calls (INT-PL-73). Ingestion reports a source that does not deliver (REQ-IN-009).

text: The system shall accept from Actuation the record of each act on the outside world before the act, and the result of that act after its call.
rationale: OPN-082 and DEC-169. REQ-AC-023 gives the record before the act and REQ-AC-030 completes it. INT-PL-43.

text: The system shall give Actuation the records of the acts on the outside world.
rationale: OPN-082 and DEC-169. Actuation holds no body, and it reads the records to know which calls returned no result (REQ-AC-024) and which released gated units it did (REQ-AC-025). INT-PL-49.

text: The system shall accept from External Access the record of each call.
rationale: OPN-082. REQ-EX-030 gives it. The cost, the state of each service and the cost of each agent come from it. INT-PL-73.

text: The system shall hold each fact about the platform that a system reports.
rationale: DEC-162 sends each report that names no receiver to this system, and DEC-120 holds data about the platform here.

text: The system shall hold the data about the quality of agents that a caller writes.
rationale: DEC-164. A set for an evaluation, its reference answers and the results of an evaluation or of a comparison of agents are data about the platform.

text: The system shall state the writer and the time of each record that it holds, and shall not accept either from the writer.
rationale: REQ-PL-029. A record of an act or of a call is evidence of what the platform did only if its writer cannot state its own circumstance.

text: The system shall accept a call of a caller to an act that it holds, and a released gated unit whose act it holds, only from Actuation, with the caller or the raiser that Actuation states.
rationale: REQ-PL-032 and DEC-111. An agent reads and writes this system through acts, as it does each other holder.

text: The system shall not serve to a caller a record that the position of that caller does not admit.
rationale: REQ-PL-024. The records of acts and of calls name agents and services from every domain of the life of the user.

text: The system shall not accept a write from a caller whose position does not admit it.
rationale: REQ-PL-024.

text: The system shall not remove a record until the platform records an affirmative answer to a request that states the selection of that removal.
rationale: DEC-113 gates the removal of data in the system that holds it, and REQ-PL-026 lets the user remove it. DEC-169 lets the user remove any record of an act.

text: The system shall give the caller, with each refusal of an act that has no affirmative answer of the user, that the act needs an affirmative answer of the user.
The system shall refuse a released gated unit whose act the position of its raiser does not admit.
rationale: REQ-PL-005, as at each holder (REQ-ST-054).

text: The system shall give the metered cost of the current month and its limit, as External Access gives them.
rationale: REQ-PL-017 and REQ-PL-020. DEC-165: External Access sums the cost for its limit, and one sum of one cost does not drift (DEC-019). INT-PL-120. A fixed cost, such as a subscription, is known before the month and is not metered, so the limit of DEC-165 is set below USD 50 by that cost.

text: The system shall give, for each agent and for each period of TBD, the share of the units of work for which the agent was responsible that closed with no result.
rationale: DEC-164. Work and Coordination gives each close (REQ-WC-096).

text: The system shall give, for each agent and for each period of TBD, the share of its requests for an affirmative answer that the user did not affirm.
rationale: DEC-164. Work and Coordination gives each answer (REQ-WC-097).

text: The system shall raise a unit of work that names no agent for each condition that a system reports, while no unit of work that it raised for that condition is open.
rationale: DEC-162 and DEC-163. A fact that no condition escalates reaches nobody, so each condition reaches an agent. A condition is what one requirement of a system that reports states, such as a source that did not deliver, and not each instance of it. One open unit for each condition keeps a fault that repeats from raising a unit each time, and the agent reads each instance here. INT-PL-110.

text: The system shall raise a unit of work that names no agent when a measure that it holds passes a threshold that it holds.
rationale: DEC-163. A system that answers slowly, a host that fills and a rate that falls report nothing by themselves. INT-PL-110.

text: The system shall give Interaction a notice of each unit of work that it raised and that Work and Coordination refused or did not send to an agent within TBD.
rationale: DEC-163. A fault on the path of work stops the unit that would tell the user, so the notice goes to the user by a path with no agent. OPN-098. INT-PL-111.

text: The system shall give Interaction the facts, the measures and the records that it holds.
rationale: REQ-PL-017. The user must see the state of the platform when no agent can answer. OPN-098 asks how Interaction shows it. INT-PL-112.

text: The system shall accept the declaration, the change and the removal of a threshold over a measure that it holds.
rationale: DEC-166 and REQ-PL-031. An agent states each threshold of REQ-SO-021 and can change it as the platform learns what is normal.

text: The system shall not accept from a caller a write to a record of an act or of a call.
rationale: RSK-SO-001. Actuation and External Access give these records under their interfaces (REQ-SO-004, REQ-SO-006), and no call of a caller writes them. A record that an agent can write is no evidence of what the platform did.

text: The system shall report each measure that it holds and that has no threshold.
rationale: RSK-SO-003. The report is a fact (DEC-162), so REQ-SO-020 raises a unit of work and an agent declares a threshold (REQ-SO-024). This system reports to itself, and REQ-SO-020 raises from the report as from the report of each other system.

text: The system shall not serve the record of an act to a caller whose position does not admit that act.
rationale: RSK-SO-006. The arguments of an act carry life data, and the act states the domain of that data.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination, for each unit of work that closes, the agent responsible for it and whether it closed with a result.
rationale: REQ-WC-096 gives it, and REQ-SO-017 gives the rate from it. INT-PL-108.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination, for each answer of the user to a request for an affirmative answer, the agent that raised the request and whether the answer is affirmative.
rationale: REQ-WC-097 gives it, and REQ-SO-018 gives the rate from it. INT-PL-109.

text: The system shall accept from each system each fact about the platform that it reports.
rationale: DEC-162. REQ-SO-007 holds it. INT-PL-114 to INT-PL-118.

text: The system shall accept from External Access the metered cost of the current month and its limit.
rationale: DEC-165. REQ-SO-016 gives it. INT-PL-120.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination the state of each unit of work that it raised, and each refusal of such a unit.
rationale: REQ-SO-022 gives a notice from it. REQ-WC-009 gives the state and REQ-WC-031 gives a refusal to the raiser. INT-PL-113.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination the number of units of work that it holds and that are not closed.
rationale: REQ-WC-033 gives it, and REQ-SO-021 escalates it at a threshold. INT-PL-121.

text: The system shall hold a threshold of TBD for each measure from the time that the measure first exists, until an agent changes it.
rationale: RSK-SO-003 and DEC-166. With no threshold, a fault in a measure reaches nobody until an agent is asked to declare one. REQ-SO-026 still reports a measure whose threshold an agent removed.

text: The system shall accept from Work and Coordination and from State Custody the time at which each last evaluated its conditions.
rationale: REQ-WC-110 and REQ-ST-087 give it, and REQ-SO-021 escalates it at a threshold, as REQ-SO-034 does for the count of units. INT-PL-127 and INT-PL-128.
